transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Back in 2025 I was hanging around Shanghai for a couple days and just wandered into a bunch of touristy spots like I was doing my own little attractions crawl.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: And earlier that same year I’d taken the high-speed rail from Beijing down to Shanghai — the ride itself was honestly the calmest part of that whole trip.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: My coworker also had a work stay in Shenzhen around then, and she kept talking about how hotel-hunting there was way more stressful than she expected.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: For Shanghai sightseeing, my cousin Yang Yu had already sorted out tickets for the Oriental Pearl Tower for 2025-03-27.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: He picked the morning time slot, and it was for 2 people — he said the views were great but the lines still moved slow.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: On the Shenzhen side, my friend Tang Xue stayed at the Grand Hyatt Shenzhen and checked in on 2025-04-22.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: She did 3 nights, and meanwhile another friend, Sophia Garcia, had taken train G3 on 2025-04-02 in First Class — she wouldn’t stop bragging about the seat.

intent.ambiguity_notes: Negative intent: all details are past-tense reminiscences about trips and bookings that were already handled; no request for help or action.
